capabilities.name: Integrated Terminal Host
capabilities.description: Provide integrated terminal sessions connected to project context and suite operations.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.1 Terminal host profiles tabs and process lifecycle

capabilities.name: Terminal Profiles
capabilities.description: Support shell profiles, environment variables, starting directories, encoding, and restorable terminal configuration.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.1 Terminal host profiles tabs and process lifecycle

capabilities.name: Terminal Tabs and Splits
capabilities.description: Provide multiple terminal tabs and split views with persistent layout metadata.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.1 Terminal host profiles tabs and process lifecycle

capabilities.name: Process Lifecycle Tracking
capabilities.description: Track process IDs, working directories, commands, duration, exit codes, output, and termination state for terminal operations.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.1 Terminal host profiles tabs and process lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Shell crashes and suite restarts must not corrupt project state.

capabilities.name: Restorable Terminal Metadata
capabilities.description: Persist terminal layout and history metadata without silently replaying commands after restart.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.1 Terminal host profiles tabs and process lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Persistence records terminal state, not automatic command execution.

capabilities.name: Live Project and Filesystem Synchronization
capabilities.description: Detect external file creation, modification, rename, deletion, generated output, and relevant project changes without requiring full reloads.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.2 Live project and filesystem synchronization
capabilities.notes: Watchers must expose degraded mode and support pause or resume for very large trees.

capabilities.name: External Change Conflict Handling
capabilities.description: Detect and resolve conflicts between unsaved in-app edits and files modified by terminal or external processes.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.2 Live project and filesystem synchronization
capabilities.notes: External changes may not silently overwrite unsaved application state.

capabilities.name: Structured Terminal Events
capabilities.description: Convert recognized terminal and process activity into typed events while preserving original raw output.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.3 Terminal event and problem integration
capabilities.notes: Events may later feed workflows, Command Center, extensions, and Copilot according to permissions.

capabilities.name: Terminal Problem and Artifact Extraction
capabilities.description: Recognize diagnostics, file paths, URLs, test results, build artifacts, and known command outputs and expose navigable results.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.3 Terminal event and problem integration
capabilities.notes: Raw terminal output must remain available even when structured interpretations are produced.

capabilities.name: Terminal and Workflow Interoperation
capabilities.description: Expose workflow steps as terminal commands and reviewed terminal commands as workflow steps.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.4 Workflow plugin and extension CLI synchronization

capabilities.name: Extension Terminal Integration
capabilities.description: Allow approved extensions to register terminal and CLI capabilities through declared schemas, help metadata, completion, and permissions.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.4 Workflow plugin and extension CLI synchronization
capabilities.notes: Extensions must not obtain undeclared shell access through command registration.

capabilities.name: Terminal-Driven Task Creation
capabilities.description: Create and update suite tasks, milestones, builds, exports, and validation jobs from approved terminal activity.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.4 Workflow plugin and extension CLI synchronization

capabilities.name: Workspace Trust and Restricted Mode
capabilities.description: Restrict unknown or untrusted projects from performing dangerous shell, network, extension, credential, or automated operations.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.5 Safety trust audit and AI command review

capabilities.name: Terminal Command Audit Trail
capabilities.description: Record visible local audit metadata for commands, providers, working directories, permissions, results, and affected resources.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.5 Safety trust audit and AI command review
capabilities.notes: Sensitive values must be redacted from audit and diagnostic output.

capabilities.name: AI Command Proposal and Review
capabilities.description: Allow AI to propose and explain terminal commands while requiring the same trust and approval boundaries as human-triggered risky operations.
capabilities.source: v1.5 Live Terminal and Workflow Synchronization — Wave 1.5.5 Safety trust audit and AI command review
capabilities.notes: AI may not silently execute destructive, privileged, remote-download, credential, or hidden-shell commands.
